04 · the words I couldn't say
Still waiting.
IT'S BEEN YEARS, MONTHS, DAYS, HOURS, MINUTES, SECONDS... STILL WAITING FOR YOU WITH 0.1% HOPE. BUT YOU DON'T LOVE ME. I WANT A CERTAIN REASON WHY YOU DON'T LOVE ME. I DON'T KNOW WHY I AM STILL WAITING FOR YOU. MY HEART SAYS YOU — AND END OF THE LIST. SOMETIMES I REALLY WANT TO LOVE SOMEONE, BUT THAT FEELING IS ONLY FOR HOURS, SOMETIMES MINUTES, AND AGAIN, AFTER THAT, THERE IS ONLY ONE IN MY MIND — YOU. THERE IS NO REASON WHY I LOVE YOU. THE ONLY THING NOWADAYS SLOWLY FORGETTING THE REASON IS MY SISTER (HIMA). BUT THE TRUTH IS, I WILL NEVER LEAVE YOU. IF THERE IS A CHANCE TO LOVE SOMEONE, I STILL CAN'T FORGET YOU. YOUR PLACE IN MY HEART IS FOREVER, UNTIL MY LAST BREATH. I WROTE SO MANY MESSAGES FOR YOU THAT ARE CRYING IN MY LIST BOX, BUT ONE DAY YOU WILL KNOW ALL ABOUT MY LOVE. THE FACT IS, YOU NEVER THINK ABOUT ME. ONE THING IS TRUE: YOU LOVE ME OR YOU DON'T LOVE ME, I WANT YOU HAPPY AND SETTLED IN YOUR LIFE, BECAUSE YOU'RE MY FIRST LOVE. YOU'RE THE GIRL I CRY FOR EVERY DAY, EVERY NIGHT, AND NOW. FINALLY, MY LOVE IS A BIRD WITHOUT WINGS. IT IS A BIRD... BUT IT CAN'T FLY.
